turn.context: Processes place, turn 1 (the trial, day by day: three quiet days first, then the changes in two steps).

text: Here is the trial, day by day. Nothing changes for the first three days, so we get the ward’s own starting times.
Then the changes come in two steps. On days 12 to 14 we read the numbers together.
chat.invite: Next, we can see who has to agree before day 1.
chat.note: Three quiet days first. Then we know what changed.
prompts: Who has to agree to this?
What changes on the ward, step by step?
Which ward should we start on?
chat.pointer: Play the two weeks, or pick a part of the trial to open it.

blocks.title: Two weeks on one ward
blocks.deck: Fourteen days, in four parts. Nothing changes in the first three.

ward.label: The ward whose consultants decide latest
ward.note: They gain the most, so the change shows fastest. You pick the ward.
ward.ask: Which ward would you start on?

needs: The one-tap form on a ward phone
One person to record the times

phases.title: Insurance and family the night before

blocks.condition: Goals for each measure are set on day 3, from the ward’s own times. None are guessed now.

sheets.title: Record today’s times
sheets.text: Nothing changes yet. The ward records when each patient is ready to go and when they leave.

lines.label: Recorded
lines.value: Ready to go home, Left the ward

sheets.entry: What would get in the way on these days?

sheets.title: The evening round starts it
sheets.text: Doctors mark likely discharges on the evening round. The night nurse starts the papers and the bill.

lines.label: Recorded
lines.value: Decided on the evening round, Papers ready by the morning round

sheets.entry: What would get in the way on these days?

sheets.title: Insurance and family the night before
sheets.text: The insurance desk sends its request the evening before. The family hears the leaving time that night.

lines.label: Recorded
lines.value: Insurance approval time, Family told the night before

sheets.entry: What would get in the way on these days?

sheets.title: Read the numbers
sheets.text: Compare the trial days with days 1 to 3. Then choose: adjust and try again, or spread to more wards.

lines.value: Hours from ready to home, Patients home by 10 AM
